turns.question: Which day had the highest revenue in October 2026, and how much was it?
turns.answer: The highest-revenue day in October 2026 was 2026-10-01, with revenue of EUR 981.69 (non-cancelled orders, that single day). Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
